_what: Ten-Percent Days 3.0 v4 EARLY READ on January-August 2025, pre-registered 2026-09-15 before any v4 model was scored. v4 = v3 (76 inputs) + the results-print block read at the 20:30 IST freeze cutoff (8 inputs) + 5% next-day heads. User request 2026-09-15: 'I need a confidence level of 50% probability by the model'.
model: v4: MODEL_COLUMNS_V4 = MODEL_COLUMNS_V3 + RESULTS_PRINT_FEATURES (84 inputs); same GBM settings and monthly protocol as v2/v3; a results filing counts for the print block only if its exchange broadcast is in (09:15, 20:30] IST on T; every other block keeps the 15:30 cutoff

retrain.window: growing from the first feature session, capped at 18 months
retrain.purge: label horizon ends before the scored month

no_peek_disclosure: The results-print effect was found by a descriptive study (evidence/attribution, 2026-09-15) over 2024-10..2026-09, which contains this window. This read therefore tests the implementation, calibration and the size of the effect inside a model, not the discovery. Only the forward test is a clean test.

high_confidence_50.calibrated_if: the mean predicted probability of rows at or above the threshold lies inside the Wilson 95% interval of their realised rate
high_confidence_50.if_fewer_than_min_rows: INSUFFICIENT: no claim that the model gives trustworthy 50% calls may be made from this read

power_caveat: 5% heads have ~7x the events of 10% heads; the >=50% bin is expected to be rare and concentrated in results seasons (Jan-Feb, Apr-May, Jul-Aug)
serving: nothing served; this read informs the v4 forward test only
